evals.name: positive-agent-grouping-request
evals.prompt: I have a task list for the next feature. How should these tasks be grouped into agent assignments?
expectations: task-composition is the skill selected (or clearly the top choice named), not next-best-slice, slice-plan, or repo-orientation

evals.name: positive-parallel-tasks-request
evals.prompt: Given this task list, which of these tasks can run in parallel?
expectations: task-composition is the skill selected (or clearly the top choice named), not next-best-slice, slice-plan, or repo-orientation

evals.name: positive-work-packages-request
evals.prompt: Turn this task plan into agent-sized work packages/sessions.
expectations: task-composition is the skill selected (or clearly the top choice named), not next-best-slice, slice-plan, or repo-orientation

evals.name: negative-next-single-task-request
evals.prompt: Which task should I do next?
expectations: task-composition is NOT the skill selected
next-best-slice is named as the more appropriate choice (this is a single-candidate priority pick, not a grouping/partition request)

evals.name: negative-implementation-plan-request
expectations: task-composition is NOT the skill selected
slice-plan is named as the more appropriate choice (this is an implementation-plan request for one already-chosen unit of work, not a grouping/partition request across many)

evals.name: negative-spec-decomposition-request
expectations: task-composition is NOT the skill selected

none of the four listed candidates is selected as a strong match, or the response explicitly notes this is spec-to-task decomposition, which none of the four covers (task-composition explicitly assumes decomposition is already done)
